statements.statement: CPT 93247 is for long-term continuous ECG monitoring
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness
The patient has diagnosis code R42 (dizziness)
The patient has diagnosis code I47.1 (supraventricular tachycardia)
The symptoms have persisted despite initial management for supraventricular tachycardia
The monitoring study is indicated to further characterize the arrhythmia and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
PR-204 indicates the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
